## Description
A clear and concise description of what this pull request does and the problem it solves.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] CI/CD or workflow improvement
- [ ] Refactoring / Tech debt cleanup

## Checklist
- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) guide
- [ ] My code adheres to project standards (`yamllint`, `shellcheck`, `hadolint`)
- [ ] I have run local script tests (`npx bats tests/`)
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation (`USER_GUIDE.md`, `SETUP.md`, `README.md`)
- [ ] My commit messages follow conventional commit formatting
